evidenceWall.Name: Evidence Wall
evidenceWall.Base: Lawmen working an ongoing investigation here get +2 to Composition, Criminology, Cryptography, Deduction, Education, Forgery, Library Search and Photography/Film Checks.
evidenceWall.Upgrade: The Lawman bonus rises to +3. Medias can use the wall too, and a story they build on it counts their Credibility Rank as 1 higher for Believability when it's published.

garage.Name: Garage
garage.Tag: A crew car and room to work on it
garage.Base: Comes with a Compact Groundcar the crew owns. It can take Vehicle Upgrades but can't be sold, and the Nomad Moto Role Ability doesn't apply to it. If it's destroyed beyond repair, the Garage and its Upgrade are lost with no refund.
garage.Upgrade: A Nomad can spend a week of downtime to re-pick their Moto Role Ability choices (vehicles or Vehicle Upgrades), as long as all their vehicles are working and at full HP.

lockup.Name: Lockup
lockup.Base: A soundproof cell for one prisoner. Breaking out takes BODY 13 or higher.
lockup.Upgrade: Holds up to three prisoners in separate cells. Lawmen get +2 to Interrogation Checks on a prisoner who has been held at least a day.

lounge.Name: Lounge
lounge.Base: During in-person meetings here, Fixers get +2 to Bribery, Bureaucracy, Business, Conversation, Human Perception, Persuasion and Trading Checks.
lounge.Upgrade: Fixers (contacts and clients) and Medias (access and sources) get +2 to Checks to set up those in-person meetings, as the GM sees fit.

medbay.Name: Medbay
medbay.Base: The crew heals naturally as if their BODY were 2 higher. Medtechs get +2 to First Aid, Paramedic and Surgery Checks here.
medbay.Upgrade: Medtechs can use Science (Chemistry) to upgrade, fabricate and invent street drugs as if they had the Maker Role Ability, with Expertise equal to their Medical Tech level.

moraleBoost.Name: Morale Boost
moraleBoost.Tag: Comforts that keep the crew human
moraleBoost.Base: Recreation and decor that make the place feel like home. Every crew member's monthly Lifestyle cost drops by 50eb. It has ten numbered Upgrades, each adding a benefit; some later ones replace earlier ones.

rentReduction.Name: Rent Reduction
rentReduction.Base: Rent is charged one row lower on the Real Estate table (skipping corp-provided rows); a Cube Hotel room drops to 100eb a month. It can't apply to an HQ the crew doesn't pay rent on.
rentReduction.Upgrade: Each Upgrade adds one bed (and, if the GM agrees, a room) with no extra Housing cost, up to double the HQ's original number of beds.

serverRoom.Name: Server Room
serverRoom.Base: Also costs 20,000eb, spent on home defenses using the Home Security 2045 rules (CP:R p. 217). What's bought can't be resold or removed, and unspent money is lost.
serverRoom.Upgrade: Netrunners can upgrade, fabricate and invent cyberdecks, cyberdeck hardware and programs as if they had the Maker Role Ability, with Expertise equal to their Interface Rank.

studio.Name: Studio
studio.Base: Rockerboys get +2 to Acting, Composition, Play Instrument, Paint/Draw/Sculpt and Photography/Film Checks here.
studio.Upgrade: Spend a week of downtime per round of refinement on a project for a stacking +2 on related Checks. Rolling a 1 wipes the built-up bonus. The GM may allow Legendary (DV29) projects.

trainingArea.Name: Training Area
trainingArea.Base: Spend a week of downtime to Practice one of: Athletics, Archery, Autofire, Brawling, Evasion, Handgun, Heavy Weapons, Martial Arts, Melee Weapon or Shoulder Arms. It gets +1 until the crew next earns Group IP or Practices again.
trainingArea.Upgrade: Solos can Practice two Skills from the list instead of one.

workshop.Name: Workshop
workshop.Base: When a Tech spends time on Upgrade, Fabrication or Invention Expertise here, the same time also counts toward a second project.
workshop.Upgrade: The same time also counts toward a third project.

workstation.Name: Workstation
workstation.Tag: An Exec team member steps up
workstation.Base: Pick one Exec Team Member when it's bought. They become an Improved Team Member: a full crew member who earns IP and an equal share of pay, and is loyal to their boss. If access to the Workstation is lost, they stop earning IP and pay but keep what they already bought.
workstation.Upgrade: The Improved Team Member ignores the Loyalty System and stays loyal unless betrayed. If an Upgraded Workstation is lost, it must be restored before any other HQ spending, or the Team Member leaves.

Morale.1: Each month, every crew member regains 1d6/2 Humanity, up to their maximum.
Morale.2: The crew heals as if their BODY were 1 higher. Stacks with the Medbay.
Morale.3: The crew gains +1 LUCK, including Exec Improved Team Members (the only way NPCs get LUCK).
Morale.4: Each month, every crew member regains 1d6 Humanity instead (replaces level 1).
Morale.5: Fixers get +2 to Trading when negotiating pay. Others can haggle for 20% more as if they had Operator Rank 5, without that bonus.
Morale.6: When Hustling, roll twice on the Hustle table and pick the result.
Morale.8: When Hustling, roll twice and earn from both rolls (replaces level 6).
Morale.9: Each month, roll 1d6 twice and regain the higher in Humanity (replaces level 4).
Morale.10: A custom benefit designed with the GM.
